enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Kicks off blanket. Pulls blanket back. Turns onto back. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Opens bathroom door. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Brushes teeth. Puts on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast while checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out cereal. Closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl. Takes out spoon. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Picks up spoon. Sits at table. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks messages. Eats cereal.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Checks phone for time. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Listens to music. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Bachelor of Business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at campus. Walks to lecture hall. Enters lecture hall. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out laptop. Opens laptop. Takes notes. Listens to lecture. Raises hand. Asks question. Continues taking notes. Lecture ends. Packs up laptop. Walks to next class.
Walks to cafeteria. Lines up. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Checks phone. Drinks water. Finishes meal. Clears table. Walks away.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and reviewing lecture notes in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to library. Enters library. Finds seat. Sits down. Opens laptop. Opens lecture notes. Reads notes. Highlights key points. Writes summary. Takes break. Checks phone. Continues studying.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting from Clayton campus to Chadstone shopping centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Listens to music. Bus stops. Exits bus. Walks to Chadstone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time retail shift at Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at store. Clocks in. Greets manager. Goes to floor. Folds clothes. Arranges shelves. Assists customer. Operates cash register. Takes break. Returns to floor. Restocks items. Cleans counter. Helps another customer. Clocks out. Leaves store.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Listens to music. Bus stops. Exits bus. Walks home.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Cooks food. Turns off stove. Plates food. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on university assignments on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Opens assignment file. Types on keyboard. Reads instructions. Takes notes. Types more. Saves file. Stretches. Continues typing. Checks phone. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp.
Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Checks phone. Watches more TV. Turns off TV. Puts down remote. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down browsing on phone with the desk lamp on, then settling into sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Lies on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Browses phone. Turns off phone. Puts phone down. Turns off desk lamp. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up. Settles into sleep.
